profile.headline: Software Engineer I @ Vital Edge Technologies | DevOps
profile.summary: Strategic IT professional with over six years of progressive experience in infrastructure management, network administration, and user support. Adept at leading cross-functional teams, mentoring staff, and delivering secure, scalable IT solutions aligned with organizational objectives. Demonstrated expertise in disaster recovery planning, system lifecycle management, vendor coordination, and policy development. Proven success reducing support requests by 83% through automation and streamlining IT operations. Skilled in regulatory compliance, cybersecurity measures, and infrastructure planning to ensure continuous service delivery.

positions.title: Jr. DevOps Engineer
positions.description: Skills: DevOps · Automation Tools · Ansible · Terraform

positions.title: IT Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with unit directors to develop and maintain long-term IT strategy plans.
•	Documented change management, technical standards, and operational procedures clearly.
•	Led technology projects across Library, CAHC, SNRC, and UA Little Rock Downtown sites.
•	Implemented disaster recovery and business continuity plans across distributed systems.
•	Coordinated user support delivery with IT Services and decentralized support units.
•	Monitored external vendor performance to ensure agreed service level quality.
•	Managed IT lifecycle tasks: installation, updates, patching, and asset tracking.
•	Administered non-LMS servers including WordPress, ArchivesSpace, and file systems.
•	Maintained archival digital storage systems and ensured long-term data availability.
•	Provided responsive in-person and remote technical support across all user levels.
•	Consulted on software selection and equipment procurement based on user needs.
•	Reduced departmental tickets by 83% through automated system maintenance workflows.
•	Shortened issue resolution time significantly using Ansible to automate frequent tasks.
•	Mentored student assistants and ensured alignment with departmental IT service goals.
positions.insights: Skills: Management · Ruby · Windows · Project Management · Information Technology · Java · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Python (Programming Language) · Powershell · Linux · Troubleshooting

company.name: University of Arkansas at Little Rock

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
•	Provided infrastructure and helpdesk support across multiple educational locations.
•	Maintained classroom hardware, configured devices, and resolved user-level issues.
•	Assisted in implementation of new digital learning technologies and systems.
•	Supported software integration aligned with school initiatives and staff needs.
•	Documented technical processes and trained staff on new IT tools and platforms.

positions.title: IT Helpdesk Technician
positions.description:
•	Delivered Tier 1 technical support to a high volume of end-users remotely.
•	Diagnosed and resolved hardware, software, and connectivity issues efficiently.
•	Created support documentation to streamline common problem-solving workflows.
•	Escalated complex issues to senior technicians while maintaining communication with users.
